sources.label: Fact Finance BRLV proof-of-reserves report - May 2026 (re-opened 2026-07-28)

reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: Fact Finance May 31, 2026 PoR PDF still returns HTTP 200 and still records Cash and equivalents R$593.72 (0.00%), Brazilian Treasury Bonds R$373,246,013.59 (99.99%), and ETFs – Brazilian Treasury R$34,130.28 (0.01%) against R$373,280,737.59 total collateral (~100.20% of R$372,522,515.00 circulating). Cash rounded to 0.00% is omitted as a positive slice. Crown EN transparency page independently restates 1:1 backing in federal government bonds under legally segregated custody at Brazilian Central Bank-regulated institutions, with live dashboard figures ~R$375.57M issued / ~R$399.24M reserves. Crown/Fact Finance report list still ends at May 2026 (no June/July monthly PoR PDF); Fact Finance live /reserves/assets/crown category names match the PDF but its BRL sums (~R$254M) disagree with published totals (~R$399M), so live asset amounts were not used for composition weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Fact Finance BRLV proof-of-reserves report as of May 31, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report identifies the reserve asset categories but does not disclose security identifiers, maturities, custodian names, or provider-level allocation. No newer monthly itemized composition PDF is published after May 2026.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Crown states that reserves are legally segregated, linked to BRLV holders through an independent collateral agent (Agente de Garantia), and held at institutions regulated by the Central Bank of Brazil under a bankruptcy-remote structure, but it does not name the custodians, allocate balances among them, or disclose rehypothecation terms. Re-opened 2026-07-28: both product and transparency pages still state those claims without naming providers.
